title: Tomato Bruschetta
description: Grilled or toasted bread rubbed with garlic and piled with juicy chopped tomatoes, basil and good olive oil. A summer classic.

image.alt: Toasts topped with chopped tomato and basil

steps.text: Toss the tomatoes with the salt in a bowl and let them stand for {time 15 min}. Drain off most of the juice, then stir in the basil, oil and vinegar.
Brush the bread lightly with oil and toast under the broiler or on a grill pan until golden and crisp on the outside, {time 1-2 min} per side.
Rub each hot toast with the cut side of the garlic.
Spoon the tomatoes onto the toasts just before serving so the bread stays crisp.

notes: Use the best, ripest tomatoes you can find; this dish depends on them.
Check the bread label; a few loaves contain milk.
